Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。

items.source:
The original form as specified when the name was created or adapted. For example:
  • "foo-bar" = "foo-bar"
  • "fooBar" = "fooBar"
  • "foo_bar" = "foo_bar"
  • "[Foo.bar]" = "Foo.bar"
items.translation:
创建或适配名称时指定的原始形式。例如：
  • "foo-bar" = "foo-bar"
  • "fooBar" = "fooBar"
  • "foo_bar" = "foo_bar"
  • "[Foo.bar]" = "Foo.bar"

items.source:
The dashed configuration form (used for toString; lower-case with only alphanumeric characters and dashes).
  • "foo-bar" = "foo-bar"
  • "fooBar" = "foobar"
  • "foo_bar" = "foobar"
  • "[Foo.bar]" = "Foo.bar"
items.translation:
虚配置形式（用于 toString；仅包含小写字母数字和连字符）。
  • "foo-bar" = "foo-bar"
  • "fooBar" = "foobar"
  • "foo_bar" = "foobar"
  • "[Foo.bar]" = "Foo.bar"

items.source:
The uniform configuration form (used for equals/hashCode; lower-case with only alphanumeric characters).
  • "foo-bar" = "foobar"
  • "fooBar" = "foobar"
  • "foo_bar" = "foobar"
  • "[Foo.bar]" = "Foo.bar"
items.translation:
统一配置表单（用于 equals/hashCode；仅包含小写字母和数字）。
  • "foo-bar" = "foobar"
  • "fooBar" = "foobar"
  • "foo_bar" = "foobar"
  • "[Foo.bar]" = "Foo.bar"

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: The various forms that a non-indexed element value can take.
items.translation: 非索引元素值可以采用的各种形式。

items.translation: 虚线配置形式（用于 toString；仅包含小写字母数字和连字符）。

items.source: The original form as specified when the name was created or adapted.
items.translation: 创建或适配名称时指定的原始表单。

items.translation: 统一配置表单（用于 equals/hashCode；仅包含小写字母和数字字符）。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if this enum class has no constant with the specified name
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果此枚举类没有指定名称的常量

items.source: NullPointerException - if the argument is null
items.translation: NullPointerException - 如果参数为 null

items.source: name - the name of the enum constant to be returned.
items.translation: name - 要返回的枚举常量的名称。
